title: Contents
slide_intent: Show how the book separates brand principles, visual rules, worked applications and management so readers can find the kind of guidance their task requires.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can direct a local communicator to the relevant section while preserving a single route through its identity.
demonstration: A short preliminary index precedes four numbered columns. Row labels and page numbers sit at opposite ends of ruled entries.
practical_value: Locate a principle, construction rule, application or management procedure using its section and page number.
